description: This file defines functions for mapping string labels and boolean options to enumeration integers, particularly for reduction operations in PyTorch's neural network modules. It includes functions for handling deprecated options and issuing warnings accordingly.

methods.name: int get_enum(reduction: str)
methods.description: Converts a reduction mode string into an integer enumeration, supporting 'none', 'mean', 'elementwise_mean' (deprecated), and 'sum'. Raises ValueError for invalid inputs.

methods.name: str legacy_get_string( size_average: bool | None, reduce: bool | None, emit_warning: bool = True, )
methods.description: Determines the reduction mode as a string based on boolean flags 'size_average' and 'reduce', with an optional warning. Supports deprecated argument usage.

methods.name: int legacy_get_enum( size_average: bool | None, reduce: bool | None, emit_warning: bool = True, )
methods.description: Converts legacy boolean flags into an integer enumeration for reduction mode, leveraging 'get_enum' and 'legacy_get_string'.

ctags.signature: ( size_average: bool | None, reduce: bool | None, emit_warning: bool = True, )
